##    Read in accelerometer data

```{r setup}

library(tidyverse)
library(leaflet)

path <- "/home/ajackson/Dropbox/Rprojects/RoughRoad/"

file <- "Portsmouth_Street-2026-08-20_19-28-35.zip"

Accel <- read_csv(unzip(paste0(path, file), "Accelerometer.csv"))
Location <- read_csv(unzip(paste0(path, file), "Location.csv"))


```

##      quick plots

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

Accel |> 
  ggplot(aes(y=z, x=seconds_elapsed)) +
  geom_line()+
  labs(title="Z-axis values")

Accel |> 
  ggplot(aes(x=z)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth=0.05) +
  labs(title="Z-axis values")

# what is interval for locations?

Location |> 
  mutate(Interval=seconds_elapsed - lag(seconds_elapsed)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x=Interval)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth=0.05) +
  labs(title="Interval between locations in seconds")

# what is bearing?

Location |> 
  ggplot(aes(x=bearing)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth=5) +
  labs(title="Bearing in degrees",
       subtitle="Zero degrees equals north")

# what is speed?

Location |> 
  ggplot(aes(x=speed)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth=0.2) +
  labs(title="Speed in m/s",
       subtitle="Roughly double values for mph")
```

##    The map

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

points_data <- Location |> 
  mutate(speed=2.2369*speed) |> #   convert to mph
  rename(lat=latitude, lon=longitude) |> 
  mutate(id=as.character(speed)) |> 
  select(id, speed, lat, lon)  

leaflet(points_data) %>%
  addTiles() %>%
  addMarkers(lng = ~lon, lat = ~lat, popup = ~id) %>%
  addPolylines(lng = ~lon, lat = ~lat, color = "blue", weight = 3)

pal <- colorNumeric(
  palette = "YlOrRd", 
  domain = points_data$speed
)

leaflet() %>%
  addTiles() %>%
  # Draw the path connecting the points
  addPolylines(
    data = points_data,
    lng = ~lon, 
    lat = ~lat, 
    color = "grey",  # Kept grey so the colored points pop out
    weight = 3
  ) %>%
  # Draw color-coded circle markers for the points
  addCircleMarkers(
    data = points_data,
    lng = ~lon, 
    lat = ~lat, 
    radius = 8,
    fillColor = ~pal(speed), # Use the color palette function
    color = "black",         # Border color
    weight = 1,              # Border thickness
    fillOpacity = 0.9,
    popup = ~paste0("<b>", id, "</b><br>Speed: ", speed, " mph") # Include speed in popup
  ) %>%
  # Add a legend to explain the colors
  addLegend(
    data = points_data,
    pal = pal, 
    values = ~speed, 
    title = "Speed (mph)",
    position = "bottomright"
  )

```
